Moored motion — 1 buoy, 1 cluster and the 4×4 platform

Steady-state response to a regular wave (heading 0°, +x) with the station-keeping mooring: four soft lines, horizontal at the still-water line, to wall anchors ±5 m (T_surge ≈ 15 s). Lines are coloured by their live tension. Motion is shown at true scale by default. Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, double-click to reset the view.

Mooring layout — plan and side view, to scale

X-spread of four soft lines (linear spring + low-stretch rope) from wall anchors 5 m up- and downstream, attached at the still-water line: the buoy's spar collar, the cluster's four spars (one line each), and the platform's upstream and downstream rows of four spars through two-leg bridles.

Data: FloatSim — deck bodies with the coupled Capytaine BEM (Cummins radiation, velocity-level KKT pins), the deck's Morison drag elements on spar and heave plate (FloatSim's still-water form), and the mooring as FloatSim Catenary lines (elastic, pretensioned, anchored on the walls at the still-water line; the platform's bridles are two lines per anchor). Frames are FloatSim's own output over the last two wave periods of the settled run, shown as displacements from FloatSim's unmoored equilibrium; the moored cluster and platform start from FloatSim's settled moored equilibrium. Line tension = FloatSim's catenary line force. H = 0.1 m keeps the lone free buoy below the ~13° pitch where FloatSim's yaw goes unstable. Mooring off plays the same wave from a separate run of the free-floating article. The mooring barely changes the wave-frequency motion, but on the cluster and platform its pretension adds a static buoy tilt ("static" in the readout). Not shown: the mean drift offset (the time-domain model has no splash-zone drift; the readout quotes its upper bound). Rigid skeleton per the joint topology: each buoy's spar hangs from its pin and tilts with the buoy. Validity: FloatSim integrates rotations with small-angle kinematics (full rotation kinematics, "LEVEL2", are not yet wired). Tilts above 0.1 rad (5.7°) are outside that range and are flagged ⚠ as indicative only; that includes the near-resonance cases and the moored platform's static pretension tilt.
